metadata.acknowledgement: This catalog includes terms and definitions from the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO), version 2026-09-01. HPO does not endorse OPORA.
metadata.citation: Köhler S, Doelken SC, Mungall CJ, Bauer S, Firth HV, et al. The Human Phenotype Ontology project: linking molecular biology and disease through phenotype data. Nucleic Acids Research. 2014;42(D1):D966-D974. doi:10.1093/nar/gkt1026.
metadata.licenseConditions: Acknowledge and cite the HPO Consortium, identify the source version when displayed publicly, and do not alter HPO vocabulary content or logical relationships. OPORA body-area classifications below are separately authored application metadata.

entries.label: Fever
entries.definition: Body temperature elevated above the normal range.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: OPORA grouping for a symptom that is not localized to one body area; the source definition describes body temperature.

entries.label: Headache
entries.definition: Cephalgia, or pain sensed in various parts of the head, not confined to the area of distribution of any nerve.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly locates the pain in the head.

entries.label: Nausea
entries.definition: A sensation of unease in the stomach together with an urge to vomit.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly refers to a sensation in the stomach; the broader system label is OPORA's grouping.

entries.label: Vomiting
entries.definition: Forceful ejection of the contents of the stomach through the mouth by means of a series of involuntary spasmic contractions.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition refers to stomach contents and the mouth; the broader system label is OPORA's grouping.

entries.label: Abdominal pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the abdomen.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly says the sensation originates in the abdomen.

entries.label: Diarrhea
entries.definition: Abnormally increased frequency (usually defined as three or more) loose or watery bowel movements a day.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition refers to bowel movements; the broader system label is OPORA's grouping.

entries.label: Constipation
entries.definition: Infrequent or difficult evacuation of feces.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition refers to evacuation of feces; the broader system label is OPORA's grouping.

entries.label: Cough
entries.definition: A sudden, audible expulsion of air from the lungs through a partially closed glottis, preceded by inhalation.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly refers to air expelled from the lungs.

entries.label: Chest pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the chest.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the chest.

entries.label: Back pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the back.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the back.

entries.label: Fatigue
entries.definition: A subjective feeling of tiredness characterized by a lack of energy and motivation.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: OPORA grouping for a symptom without a single anatomical location in the HPO definition.

entries.label: Palpitations
entries.definition: A sensation that the heart is pounding or racing, which is a non-specific sign but may be a manifestation of arrhythmia.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly identifies a sensation of the heart pounding or racing; Chest is OPORA's visible body-area grouping.

entries.label: Weight loss
entries.definition: Reduction of total body weight.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition refers to total body weight rather than one anatomical location.

entries.label: Chills
entries.definition: A sudden sensation of feeling cold.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: OPORA grouping for a sensation without a single anatomical location in the HPO definition.

entries.label: Night sweats
entries.definition: Occurrence of excessive sweating during sleep.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition describes sweating during sleep without a single anatomical location.

entries.label: Nasal congestion
entries.definition: Reduced ability to pass air through the nasal cavity often leading to mouth breathing.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly refers to the nasal cavity.

entries.label: Ear pain
entries.definition: Pain in the ear can be a consequence of otologic disease (primary or otogenic otalgia), or can arise from pathologic processes and structures other than the ear (secondary or referred otalgia).
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO label and definition explicitly identify ear pain; the definition also preserves its qualification about referred pain.

entries.label: Blurred vision
entries.definition: Lack of sharpness of vision resulting in the inability to see fine detail.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: OPORA groups this vision symptom under Eyes; this is an application classification, not an HPO assertion about anatomy.

entries.label: Wheezing
entries.definition: A high-pitched whistling sound associated with labored breathing.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly associates the sound with breathing.

entries.label: Red eye
entries.definition: A reddish appearance over the white part (sclera) of the eye ranging from a few enlarged blood vessels appearing as wiggly lines over the sclera to a bright red color completely covering to sclera.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly locates the appearance on the sclera of the eye.

entries.label: Poor appetite
entries.definition: A reduced desire to eat.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: OPORA grouping for a symptom without a single anatomical location in the HPO definition.

entries.label: Hoarse voice
entries.definition: Hoarseness refers to a change in the pitch or quality of the voice, with the voice sounding weak, very breathy, scratchy, or husky.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition describes voice quality without specifying one anatomical location; General is OPORA's unlocalized grouping.

entries.label: Neck pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the neck.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the neck.

entries.label: Shoulder pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the shoulder.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the shoulder.

entries.label: Dry skin
entries.definition: Skin characterized by the lack of natural or normal moisture.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO label and definition explicitly refer to skin.

entries.label: Skin rash
entries.definition: A red eruption of the skin.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO label and definition explicitly refer to skin.

entries.label: Muscle weakness
entries.definition: Reduced strength of muscles.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly refers to muscles.

entries.label: Joint stiffness
entries.definition: Joint stiffness is a perceived sensation of tightness in a joint or joints when attempting to move them after a period of inactivity. Joint stiffness typically subsides over time.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly identifies a sensation in one or more joints.

entries.label: Hand pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort localized to the hand.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the hand.

entries.label: Knee pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the knee.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the knee.

entries.label: Foot pain
entries.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the foot.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The HPO definition explicitly localizes the sensation to the foot.

entries.label: Productive cough
entries.definition: A cough that produces phlegm or mucus.
entries.oporaMappingRationale: The source term is a cough and its definition describes production of phlegm or mucus.
